parameters.content:
## 🤖 Blogger MCP Server for AI Agents

This workflow exposes Google **Blogger** as a set of tools (MCP server) that any AI agent (Claude, GPT, etc.) can call to manage a blog — create/edit/delete posts, static pages, comments, and view stats.

⚙️ Before using this workflow, you MUST set up your own credentials and variables. See the notes below for step-by-step setup.

## 🔑 Step 1: Set n8n Variables

Go to **Settings → Variables** and add:

1. `google_blogger_api_key`
   → Your Blogger API key from Google Cloud Console
   (Enable "Blogger API v3" in your GCP project first)

2. `google_blogger_blog_id`
   → Your Blogger Blog ID
   → Find it via Blogger dashboard URL, or call the
     "List My Blogs" tool after connecting OAuth below

Both are referenced in every tool node as:
{{$vars.google_blogger_api_key}}
{{$vars.google_blogger_blog_id}}

## 🔐 Step 2: Connect Credentials

Each tool node needs its own credential connection:

1. **Bearer Auth** (on MCP Server Trigger node)
   → Set any secret token — this protects your MCP endpoint URL.
   → Share this token only with the AI agent/app calling this server.

2. **Google OAuth2** (on all Blogger action nodes)
   → Create a Google Cloud OAuth2 credential
   → Enable "Blogger API v3"
   → Scope needed: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/blogger
   → Connect your Google account that owns/manages the blog

⚠️ Do not skip this — the workflow will not run without your own credentials.

## 🚀 Step 3: Use It

Once variables + credentials are set:

1. Activate this workflow
2. Copy the MCP Server Trigger's webhook URL
3. Add it as an MCP server in your AI tool (Claude, n8n AI Agent, etc.), using the Bearer token you set above as the Authorization header

Available actions: create/update/patch/delete posts, publish/revert/schedule, search posts, manage static pages, list/approve/delete/flag comments, get blog info & pageview stats.

## Comment moderation tools

Moderates Blogger comments by approving them, flagging them as spam, or deleting them.

## Post writing tools

A far-right cluster for creating new Blogger posts and updating existing posts using full update or patch operations.

## MCP server entry

Exposes the workflow as an MCP server so Ai Agent can discover and call the Blogger-related tools.

## Post lookup tools

A left-side cluster of Blogger API tools for finding posts by ID or path, listing blog posts, and searching posts.

## Post lifecycle tools

Handles nearby post management actions such as deleting, publishing, and reverting posts, with adjacent tools for reading blog information and comments.

## Pages and stats

A central cluster for managing Blogger static pages, checking page view statistics, and listing the user's blogs.
